messages:
maria: quick question — running into an issue where ExternalSecrets inline template annotations aren't updating when Vault rotates a key. created an ExternalSecret that templates `metadata.annotations.last-lease` but it stays the same after rotation. any ideas?

alex: do you mean external-secrets operator (external-secrets.io) or the older kube-external-secrets?

maria: external-secrets.io operator (v0.7.1). here's the ES yaml snippet: 
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: svc-api-creds
spec:
  refreshInterval: 10s
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-store
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: svc-api-creds
    template:
      metadata:
        annotations:
          last-lease: "{{ .Data.lease_id }}"
  data:
    - secretKey: token
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/svc/api
        property: token
```

sam: hmm, template placeholders run during each reconciliation but `.Data` for secret values may not include `lease_id` unless you request the raw secret metadata. are you using the Vault KV v2 and relying on metadata?

maria: yes KV v2. When I `kubectl get secret svc-api-creds -o yaml` the annotation shows the original lease id from creation. Vault logs show a rotation event (new lease id). ES controller logs show reconcile but I don't see it updating annotations.

jia: can you paste the operator logs around reconcile? there should be a line like `reconciling externalsecret svc-api-creds` and then errors if template rendering failed.

maria: pasted small excerpt: 
```
I0403 11:04:10.123 controller.go:212] reconciling externalsecret default/svc-api-creds
I0403 11:04:10.456 store.go:98] fetched secret from vault: secret/data/svc/api (version: 3)
I0403 11:04:10.458 template.go:45] rendering template for secret svc-api-creds
I0403 11:04:10.459 template.go:46] template result: {"token":"***"}
I0403 11:04:10.460 controller.go:230] applied secret default/svc-api-creds
```

maria: notice `template result` doesn't show lease_id. maybe the fetched payload doesn't include that field?

alex: right — by default the provider returns `data.data` which is just the key/values. Lease info is not part of the `data` map. the controller does expose some `metadata` but not guaranteed in the template context.

sam: two options: 1) switch to using `secretStoreRef` provider settings to retrieve secret metadata (if supported) or 2) add a separate read path: have an init container/job that queries Vault HTTP API and writes an annotation via `kubectl annotate` when rotation happens. option 1 preferable if operator supports `metadata` in template context.

jia: check the provider docs — for vault provider there's an option `version`/`auth` config but not sure about exposing lease. some folks use the `raw` option to get full response: e.g., `remoteRef.key: secret/data/svc/api?raw=true` (not sure exact syntax).

maria: tried `property: ""` to get whole payload, but controller strips out metadata. also `refreshInterval: 10s` is set so it reconciles often. curious why it didn't pick up.

alex: another angle: your template references `{{ .Data.lease_id }}` but based on the template result it's `Data` only contains the key `token`. try a template debug: `template: |
  {{- range $k,$v := .Data }}{{ $k }}={{ $v }};{{ end }}` then see annotation.

maria: did that, output shows `token=***;`. no lease field.

sam: I'd file it as expected behavior of the operator: lease information is considered provider metadata and not part of `.Data`. we could either request feature to surface provider metadata into template context or work around.

jia: temporary workaround: annotate the Secret with the Vault version by adding a secondary ExternalSecret that uses `dataFrom` pointing to the same key but with `transform` that writes a dummy key with vault response version, then template that. bit hacky.

maria: thanks. for now I patched a small sidecar (k8s CronJob) that calls Vault and annotates the secret when lease changes. not ideal but unblocks rotation testing.

alex: if you want, open a GH issue against external-secrets operator requesting `provider.metadata` to be available in templates. include your logs and use-case. i can +1 and add reproduction.

maria: will do. tagging infra-bot to create an issue task: @infra-bot create-issue "external-secrets: expose provider metadata (vault lease) to template context"

infra-bot: created issue #2487 in infra/external-secrets (assignee: alex) :white_check_mark:

sam: one more FYI — if you're relying on annotations for rotation triggers, consider using the operator's `onUpdate` events or a controller that watches Vault change events (Vault's sys/events) instead of annotations alone. :thinking:

maria: good point. ok thanks all — i'll open the GH issue and leave the CronJob until operator supports it. :thumbsup:
